policy: An amendment extends the reviewed executable ownership denominator forward without rewriting a dated historical review event. Each amendment pins the immutable predecessor it extends, carries its own current review identity, and may record only denominator movement, source-fingerprint rebinds whose semantic ownership fields are unchanged, and tracked surfaces that receive no explicit ownership assignment under established cohort precedent. An amendment can never create, alter or remove an ownership assignment, lifecycle, functional owner, governed exclusion, exact-inventory transition or reviewed rationale. Composing two already accepted ownership authorities is not a per-surface review event: a merge composition declares both accepted inputs, carries the superseded accepted amendment of the merged input verbatim, and states in machine-checked form that it performs no primary per-surface review.

predecessor_review.note: The dated internal review of 2026-08-13 is preserved byte for byte and is not restated by this composition. It did not and could not review any executable surface created after its own date.

amendments.reason: This amendment composes two already accepted executable ownership authorities rather than reviewing surfaces. The upstream authority is current main at 99d61f7b, whose accepted reviewed denominator is 2,363 tracked executable surfaces and which carries the AI Calls pre-release production parity of PR #95. The merged authority is the identity candidate at bb20e614, whose accepted amendment had already reached 2,429 tracked executable surfaces and whose per-surface decisions are carried verbatim below. Integrating the two accepted trees yields the exact merged denominator recorded in this amendment's current triple, 2,501 tracked executable surfaces, measured by running the repository's own tracked-surface inventory over the merged tree rather than inferred from either published artifact. Relative to the accepted identity current state the integration adds the tracked surfaces contributed by accepted main; relative to the accepted main current state the arithmetic difference is the already accepted identity-branch work. This reviewer re-examined neither set surface by surface and does not claim to have reviewed either.

unassigned_tracked_surfaces.review_rationale: Route test files in this cohort are intentionally unassigned. Every tracked TEST-lifecycle surface under gravity-mvp/src/app carries no ownership assignment in the reviewed decision registry, including the four closest homologous route and route-test pairs whose runtime halves are assigned to gravity_runtime_remainder. This surface classifies as lifecycle TEST with no functional owner and unknown production capability, identically to its already accepted peer at gravity-mvp/src/app/api/contacts/[id]/driver-person/route.test.ts, so it is covered by context ownership and must not enter an APPLICATION_RUNTIME governed exclusion path inventory.

The pure amendment-resolution helper is an architecture control-plane surface classified OPERATIONAL_SCRIPT in the lifecycle registry alongside its tools/architecture siblings, under functional owner architecture_governance. Like every other tracked surface under tools/architecture it carries no explicit executable ownership assignment in the reviewed decision registry, resolves into the architecture_controls governed exclusion, and that exclusion holds no exact path inventory, so no reviewed exact-inventory transition is created.

merge_delta.delta_note: Both figures are net denominator movement, not counts of added surfaces. Relative to the accepted identity current state the movement is seventy-two additions and no retirements, contributed by the accepted main integrations this branch has taken: forty-one through PR #88 MAX production parity, sixteen through PR #91 migration authority owner context and PR #92 compensation monetary core, thirteen through PR #87 Android shell session and deeplink, and two through PR #95 AI Calls pre-release production parity. Both directions reconcile to the same merged denominator of 2501, and each of the three surface sets was produced by running the repository’s own tracked-surface inventory over that commit’s tree rather than being inferred from the published artifacts. This reviewer reviewed neither accepted set surface by surface and does not claim to have done so.
